title: Villager shoots a silver-suited hovering assailant with a shotgun

tellings.quote: And he said, "I shot him at point blank range with a shotgun." And it and the blast the shotgun, he could hear the the the BB's dink off the armor and it knocked the guy back on his butt.

plain: Tim Alberino is a researcher who has looked into reports of strange beings around the world. On Jesse Michels' podcast he relayed what a villager in the Alto Nanay area of the Peruvian Amazon told him about something that happened around 2023: a hovering attacker in a silver suit came at him, and he shot it at point-blank range with a shotgun. According to the villager, he heard the pellets ping off its armor and the blast knocked the figure onto its backside, which would mean these attackers were armored and solid.
